reuuuben.caption: It's been more than 2 years since @odysseyadvisory was founded, and I still enjoy celebrating our many wins together. I am fortunate to find myself in a family where we are all aligned to the same goals and dreams. We never play the game to lose, only to win. And win, we will.

Today I turned 33. I spent it in the office. 4:30am wake up. Breakfast. A bit of work. 7 to 9, pickleball with the team at Tanah Merah. Then the range, 50 balls. Office by noon. Lunch. Caught the tail end of overtime in the Conference Finals. Coaching call. Team meeting at 4. All day, people asked the same thing: how come you’re in the office? Isn’t it your birthday? To me, a birthday is just another day. You turn one year older. The work still needs doing. There are interns to guide. Clients to advise. Mentees to mentor. All of that matters more to me than a celebration. Because the truth is, this is where I feel the most like myself. Doing the work that actually matters. That’s the gift. @

Year 3, semester 2. NUS. I told my management professor on the first day that I wouldn’t be attending most classes, I was deep into my career and asked for leeway. He said: attend half, I’ll pass you. End of the semester, I texted him asking if anyone had ever advised him on financial planning. He remembered me, as the one who said he wouldn’t show up.
